result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mostly related to horizontal clipping and fixed navigation overlaying content.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrolling sections are clipped at the right edge. In the category filter row, a partially visible empty pill appears after “Healthy,” and in the “Fastest near you” row the third restaurant card is cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel items are intentionally clipped with proper spacing, visible partial content, or scroll affordance. Avoid showing an empty-looking partial chip without its label.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the content area. The lower restaurant card image is partially hidden behind the fixed tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The restaurant name in the rightmost “Fastest near you” card appears truncated/cut off at the screen edge, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent truncation with ellipsis within the card bounds, or adjust card width/spacing so text does not get clipped by the viewport.
